title: Choosing a Sport
setting: A sunny park with green grass, a hill and a lake.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans)

characters.name: Leo
characters.look: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie)

sentences.en: Ben, Mia and Leo choose a sport together.
sentences.zh: 本、米娅和里奥一起挑选一项运动。
sentences.scene_prompt: In a sunny park, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) stand around a pile of a football, a basketball and tennis rackets, each pointing at a different one.
sentences.narration: In a sunny park, Ben, Mia and Leo stand around a pile of a football, a basketball and tennis rackets, each pointing at a different one.

sentence_targets.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
to decide which person or thing you want

sentences.en: Leo is a fast football player.
sentences.zh: 里奥是个跑得很快的足球运动员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) runs fast and kicks a football across the green grass of the park.
sentences.narration: Leo runs fast and kicks a football across the green grass of the park.

sentence_targets.en: a game where teams kick a ball into opposing goals
someone who takes part in a sport or game

sentences.en: Mia throws a ball for a basketball game.
sentences.zh: 米娅在篮球比赛中投球。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) throws a basketball toward a hoop in the park while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) tries to block her.
sentences.narration: Mia throws a basketball toward a hoop in the park while Ben tries to block her.

sentence_targets.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
A round object used in games or shaped like one.
an activity or contest played according to rules

sentences.en: Ben thinks a tennis match is too long.
sentences.zh: 本觉得网球比赛太长了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits on a bench beside a tennis court and yawns while two players hit a ball back and forth.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben yawning while he watches a tennis match; his opinion that it is too long can only be guessed.
sentences.narration: Ben sits on a bench beside a tennis court and yawns while two players hit a ball back and forth.

sentence_targets.en: To have an opinion or belief about something.
a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets
a sports contest between two people or teams

sentences.en: Then they climb a hill to a lake.
sentences.zh: 然后他们爬上小山，来到一个湖边。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) climb a steep green hill, with a blue lake shining just over the top.
sentences.narration: Ben, Mia and Leo climb a steep green hill, with a blue lake shining just over the top.

sentence_targets.en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands

sentences.en: Ben takes off his blue jacket to swim.
sentences.zh: 本脱下蓝色夹克去游泳。
sentences.scene_prompt: At the edge of the lake, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), wearing an open blue jacket over his T-shirt, pulls the jacket off, ready to jump into the water.
sentences.narration: At the edge of the lake, Ben, wearing an open blue jacket over his T-shirt, pulls the jacket off, ready to jump into the water.

sentence_targets.en: A short coat covering the upper body and arms.
To move through water using your body.

sentences.en: Swimming is fun on a hot day.
sentences.zh: 炎热的日子里游泳很有趣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Under a bright hot sun, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie), now in swimsuits, swim and splash in the lake, laughing.
sentences.narration: Under a bright hot sun, Ben, Mia and Leo, now in swimsuits, swim and splash in the lake, laughing.

sentence_targets.en: To move through water using your body.
The activity of moving through water using your body.

sentences.en: Mia is the fastest and wins the race.
sentences.zh: 米娅游得最快，赢得了比赛。
sentences.scene_prompt: Mia (a ten-year-old girl with a short black bob, a red hair clip, a red hoodie and jeans), now in a swimsuit, reaches a big rock in the lake first and raises her arm, while Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Leo (a tall, thin sixteen-year-old boy with dark skin, short black hair and an orange hoodie) swim behind her.
sentences.narration: Mia, now in a swimsuit, reaches a big rock in the lake first and raises her arm, while Ben and Leo swim behind her.

sentence_targets.en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize.
